_comment: Audit themes: harness.py audit --theme NAME [--budget 30m]. Each theme is the union of these tags (prefix match), checks and visuals together; the audit samples within it (problems first, never-run, stalest, spread across strata). Add themes freely.

dungeons.description: Dungeon design and visuals: reachability, loops, traps, loot and lore placement, entrances near and far, interiors, caves

landscape.description: Region landscape features: terrain, mountains, volcanoes, rivers, lakes, coasts, roads, regions, hydrology, far field and horizon

flora.description: Flora placement and visuals: forests, foliage, groves, scatter and ecology, foliage shading and sway, forest seams

towns.description: Towns and cities: street plans, buildings, interiors, walls and gates, population, grounding, cities at every distance

weather.description: Weather and sky: clouds, storms, fog, rain, snow, ash, sand, lightning, night sky, moons, aurora, sunrise and sunset

renderer.description: Infinite ATLAS at every scale: ladders, hand-off sweeps, fidelity, altitude, lights, entities across the ring, player edits

lights.description: Lights and shadows: torches, windows, fires, lava at every distance, day/night, shadow maps, moonlight

creatures.description: Creatures and NPCs: gallery, animations, far actors, spawn rules, ecology, renderers, races

gear.description: Weapons, armour, items and materials: gallery sets, contracts, textures, PBR, item audits

fx.description: Effects and magic: fire, smoke, spells, staves, lightning, effects at distance, spell and alchemy data

ui.description: Screens and HUD: every screen before/after, flows, menus coverage

content.description: Quests, lore, loot, economy, uniques: references, lang keys, distributions (checks only, fast)
